findings.governingReading: something I did not even want to hear
findings.explanation: Shirou’s comic reluctance is replaced with an unsupported claim that the message is ominous.

findings.highlight: The instant I get to the door
findings.evidenceJa: まいったなあ、と教室の扉に手をかけて
findings.governingReading: Thinking “this is a pain,” I put my hand on the classroom door
findings.explanation: Shirou’s resigned reaction and concrete hand movement disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 倫理も受け持っている
findings.explanation: Kuzuki’s second subject is changed from ethics to philosophy.
The comic appraisal becomes a non-English epithet.

findings.highlight: in charge of the student council
findings.governingReading: faculty adviser to the student council
findings.explanation: Kuzuki’s advisory role is overstated as direct control.

findings.highlight: I regret that I was late
findings.evidenceJa: 覚悟の上とは言え、遅刻はやはりばつが悪い
findings.governingReading: Even though I was prepared for it, being late still feels awkward
findings.explanation: The tension between deliberate lateness and social embarrassment disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 今朝の様子はその比じゃない
findings.governingReading: his behavior this morning is beyond comparison with yesterday
findings.explanation: The marked escalation in Shinji’s instability is weakened.

findings.highlight: conceited because you’re friends with Tohsaka
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂と仲良くやっていい気になってんの
findings.governingReading: feeling full of yourself because things are going well with Tohsaka
findings.explanation: Shinji’s jealous attack on Shirou’s new alliance and rapport becomes ordinary friendship.

findings.evidenceJa: じろじろと睨め付けてくる
findings.governingReading: keeps glaring me up and down
findings.explanation: The sustained, scrutinizing quality of Shinji’s hostile gaze disappears.

findings.highlight: doesn’t seem like he has much composure
findings.evidenceJa: いつもと違ってあまりにも余裕がない
findings.governingReading: unlike usual, he is far too lacking in composure
findings.explanation: The contrast with Shinji’s normal self-presentation and its extreme degree are weakened.

findings.governingReading: it would lack a certain interest or amusement
findings.explanation: Shinji’s ominously personal anticipation is normalized into boredom.

findings.governingReading: I brought a boxed lunch again today
findings.explanation: The meal format and repetition become an unsupported claim that Shirou cooked it.

findings.highlight: The guys that are secretly talking
findings.evidenceJa: 固まって秘密会議をしている男子
findings.governingReading: the boys huddled together in a secret conference

findings.highlight: must have watched some strange TV program last night.
findings.evidenceJa: 昨日は良からぬ時代劇でも見たんだな、と納得しつつ、言うとおりにした
findings.governingReading: concluding he must have watched some dubious period drama last night, I do as he says
findings.explanation: The period-drama source of Gotou’s archaic speech and Shirou following his instruction are both lost.

findings.evidenceJa: あちらも同様の草っぷり
findings.governingReading: she too is behaving like a covert scout
findings.explanation: Gotou’s sustained period-drama spy register is flattened.

findings.highlight: she’s getting angrier the more she stays out there
findings.evidenceJa: 通りがかるたびに目尻があがってんだよなあ
findings.governingReading: the corners of her eyes rise each time she passes
findings.explanation: An observable facial change becomes a direct assertion of growing anger.
